domain: Multi-Arm Robotic Gripper for Non-Cooperative Space Debris Capture in LEO
authorized_title: How can a multi-arm robotic gripper mechanism simulated in MuJoCo utilize impedance contact control to synchronize with and capture tumbling non-cooperative orbital debris in LEO while mitigating collision impulse and momentum transfer?
